title: Barton Hall Check-In, Rushing Voc Eval in One Week, & 'Door Greeter!?'
description: Arriving at Barton Hall on Sunday, March 4, 2007 as Level 2 clients, twenty-one-year-old Katie and Nate aggressively shut down a staffer who grabs Katie's wheelchair push-handles, endure a creepy first roommate and nasty cafeteria rations, hate touring the auto shop, woodworking shop, and nursing school when they already have associate degrees and want Web Development, bristle at a ValueMart door-greeter pitch, and rush the two-week Vocational Evaluation in a single week.
